facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. Transactions with promoters holding 10% or more shareholding include director's remuneration to Mr. Amit Yamunadutt Agarwal (19.40% holding) of Rs 180 lakhs. Other promoters Mr. Yamunadutt Amilal Agrawal (13.68%) and Mrs. Madhulika Jitendra Agrawal (13.46%) had no transactions. Transactions with associate Goodcore Spintex Limited include sale of goods/services Rs 2,681.43 lakhs and purchase of goods/services Rs 410.92 lakhs.
